pages.title: Medium Laser Turret
pages.text: $(br2)A medium turret that fires lasers.$(br2)Functions only on a subspace. It consumes energy, but does not overheat.

Supports selectable targeting modes; hostile-subspace mode requires a linked Control Seat.$(br2)Very effective against entities and smaller hostile subspaces.$(br2)Maximum targeting distance/range: 256 blocks.
